|lore=ISB attaché to the ''Executor''. Detention Officer. Political Liaison for COMPNOR. Responsible for all prisoner transfers. Fiercely loyal to the Emperor’s New Order.

|notes=The Players Committee released the original-layout slip for Corporal Vandolay on 30 May 2003. The published Set 5 editions are linked as [[Corporal Vandolay (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time)|Original]] and [[Corporal Vandolay (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time) (Errata)|Remastered (2006)]]. The first sheet was released 30 May 2003 and became tournament legal on 6 June. Both editions retain the smuggler forfeit penalty and the once-per-game Immediate Effect and/or prison search. The original names one Spice Mines Of Kessel per control phase. The remaster phrases it as taking one during any control phase, subject to the [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=21 period One Rule].
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20030801181811/http://www.theforce.net/ccg/vcards/SWCCGVirtualSet5.pdf Virtual Set #5 first release sheet] (theforce.net, 30 May 2003; Internet Archive 1 August 2003), page 2, slip 32.
* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards5.pdf Virtual Set #5 revised sheet] (publisher index dates the edition 19 June 2003), res.starwarsccg.org, page 2, slip 32.
* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154714/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards5.pdf VirtualCards5.pdf] (Remaster sheet, official text as of 4 December 2006; Internet Archive 24 October 2007).
